system.description:
Valley Elf

Valley elves are a subrace that dwells in isolated mountain valleys, far from the noise and corruption of civilisation. Slender and graceful like their high-elf kin, valley elves have pale blue or grey skin and silver-white hair that helps them blend into their cold, rocky habitat. Their long isolation has made them wary of outsiders, though they are not inherently hostile. Valley elves combine elven magical gifts with a hardiness born from mountain life.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Constitution: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 90% immunity to sleep spells and +2 bonus on saving throws vs. charm and hold spells.
  • Detect Secret and Concealed Doors: 1-in-6 passively, 2-in-6 when actively searching.
  • Mountain Terrain Expertise: Valley elves are at home in mountain environments and suffer no movement penalties on rocky or steep terrain.
  • Move Silently: Valley elves move quietly in non-metal armor in rocky or mountainous terrain.
  • Weapon Proficiency Bonus: +1 to attack rolls with bows and elven blades.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Magic-User, Thief; Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Thief, Magic-User/Thief, Fighter/Magic-User/Thief multiclass.
